findings.title: DOM bounded traversal eagerly enumerates complete child collections before queue cap
findings.observed: Actual callback in Node VM fully enumerated 20000 ordinary light children and 20000 open-shadow children independently at maxEntries=1; output stayed one node/truncated=true.
findings.controls: Four-child complete summary, Network mixed response/failure metadata, Performance count/timing projection, existing inspector baseline.
findings.evidenceLevel: Actual production inspector callback + fake iterable collection; real HTMLCollection enumeration and Desktop consumers source-only.
findings.limitations: No real browser, CSS/layout engine, measured browser latency or memory peak, timeout/hang, complete tool-chain or platform acceptance.
findings.dedup: CDP-R3-03 visibility hidden pruning has a different cause and is excluded; no eager collection cap finding found in parsed historical MD/JSON.
